note: The encoder lane is pinned to one bundle: checkpoint, tokenizer, sequence limit, head, quantization and normalization. utils/q4bert/quantize.py reproduces the bundle byte for byte from the float32 checkpoint named here, so the weights digest is a pin and not a download. The observations are single masked positions observed on 2026-11-19 with this bundle; they check that the lane still returns what it returned, and say nothing about accuracy.

observations.why: "may" is the single likeliest word, yet will/would together outweigh may/can/might/could: the context reads as a prediction. The deterministic lane read permission. Routed to review.
The context alone would have said "may"; the source says "must". Contested does not mean wrong: here the obligation rests on that one word, which is why a reviewer should see it.
